title: leobordea mollis
intro: Leobordea mollis, commonly known as Himalayan lavender, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its calming effects, which help reduce anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Leobordea mollis include its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which aid in relaxation and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and other terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
